new_processes.name: Longview project information requests
new_processes.definition: Answering or routing requests for status and technical information about the Longview power project.

new_processes.name: Enpower deal entry guidance
new_processes.definition: Instructing the trading group how to enter particular deal types in Enpower.

new_processes.name: Trade tape retrieval
new_processes.definition: Arranging for recorded trade tapes to be pulled to verify a deal.

new_processes.name: ISO outage notification
new_processes.definition: Reporting generation unit outages to the CAISO outage and real-time desks, and the rules around it.

new_processes.name: Generator buy-back and decremental bidding
new_processes.definition: Coordinating with generators to buy back sold generation or submit decremental bids when the real-time market is weak.

new_processes.name: EPE reconciliation
new_processes.definition: Reconciling the El Paso Electric real-time model against the CARP report and recording results in the reconciliation sheet.

new_processes.name: Customer finals creation
new_processes.definition: Creating customer finals in CAPS or FSP by the nightly deadline so volume management can pull schedules.
